'''Three-Finger Jak''' was a criminal that individuals owed [[Currency/Legends|money]] to. Jak employed a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] and [[Human/Legends|Human]] to remind his clients of the money that was owed, and that non-payment would be unhealthy for them.<ref name="PW">{{WEGCite|book=The Far Orbit Project|story=Preparing for War}}</ref>
